newsitem.title: USA: PSE to trade Tower Semi options Jan 10.
newsitem.headline: PSE to trade Tower Semi options Jan 10.

text.p: The Paific Stock Exchange (PSE) said Tuesday it would begin trading options on Tower Semiconductor Ltd on January 10.
The exchange said the options would have initial strike prices of 7-1/2, 10 and 12-1/2, with introductory expirations in February, March, April and July.
The stock ended unchanged at 10-3/4 Tuesday.
The PSE said Tower options have been allocated to lead market maker Sheldon Kahn of Pax West.
The Philadelphia Stock Exchange plans to trade Tower options.
